_note: Shared intake question blocks. Presets list the blocks they need in 'blocks'. Questions never collect G-28, attorney, preparer, interpreter or translator information: staff complete those parts by hand.

questions.label: Other names you have used (maiden name, aliases, nicknames)
Country of citizenship or nationality
questions.help: This is not always the country where you were born. If you have no citizenship, write "stateless".

questions.label: A-Number (if any)
questions.help: Starts with A and has 8 or 9 digits. Leave blank if you never had one.

questions.label: USCIS Online Account Number (if any)
questions.help: Only if you previously filed online or received an Account Access Notice. It is not the same as an A-Number.

questions.label: Safe mailing address, if different (a place where you can safely receive mail)
Addresses for the last 5 years (from - to, full address)
Date of your last arrival in the U.S.
Place of last arrival (city and state, or port of entry)
Form I-94 number (if any)
questions.help: You can print your I-94 at i94.cbp.dhs.gov.

questions.label: Current immigration status (for example B-2, F-1, parole, none)
Date your status or I-94 expires (if any)
Have you EVER been arrested, cited, detained, charged or convicted anywhere in the world?
questions.help: Include arrests where no charges were filed and records that were sealed or expunged. Your attorney will review this privately.

questions.label: Describe each arrest or charge (date, place, what happened, outcome)
Have you ever been in immigration court (removal, deportation or exclusion proceedings)?
Prior USCIS applications or petitions filed for you (form, year, receipt number, result)
Race (you may list more than one)
Height (feet and inches, for example 5 ft 9 in)
Place of current marriage (city, state/province, country)
Prior marriages for you or your spouse (names, dates, how each ended)
Your children (full name, date of birth, country of birth, where they live now)
Your parents (full names, dates and countries of birth)
Employment for the last 5 years, most recent first (employer, address, job title, from - to)

commonChecklist.label: Government-issued photo ID (passport biographic page, even if expired)
commonChecklist.help: A clear copy of the page with your photo.

commonChecklist.label: Any document not in English (staff will arrange certified translations)
commonChecklist.help: USCIS requires a full English translation with the translator's certification for every foreign-language document. Staff add translator certifications by hand.
